fishing: WHEN: Mon Nov 16 mild fall; good bites on moving water despite front. PASSES-BEACH: redfish, whiting, pompano, sheepshead, flounder, Spanish near Englewood Beach / Manasota / Stump Pass on live shrimp, paddletails, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: redfish under mangroves and oysters, snook, trout, flounder, sheepshead on docks/flats; shrimp/spoons/pinfish working. NEARSHORE: Spanish, ladyfish, cobia, snapper when seas allow; deeper grouper. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, weedless spoons, popping cork. Sources: Fishin Franks Nov 13 (snook/reds/trout/sheepshead/pompano scattered; cold front effects), FL Sportsman SW Nov 13-15 (redfish solid 18-33" on live baits/oysters/mangroves).
redtide: FWC recent: K. brevis background to very low in SWFL samples (Sarasota, Charlotte, Pinellas, Manatee, Collier). No bloom concentrations near Englewood/Manasota. No fish kills or respiratory irritation reported. Next update soon.
bacteria: Charlotte/Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Englewood Beach / Manasota Key GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples early Nov). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota ~149 minor isolated outages; no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
